hero.subtitle: A curated marketplace of world-class vendors and the tools to orchestrate unforgettable events — beautifully, in one place.

discover.title: Discover
discover.desc: Browse a curated network of trusted vendors — venues, florals, photography, catering and more.

book.title: Book
book.desc: Check live availability, request appointments, and confirm your bookings in a few taps.

plan.title: Plan
plan.desc: Manage timelines, payments, invitations, and guest lists from one elegant dashboard.

discovery.title: Vendor discovery
discovery.desc: Search a hand-vetted marketplace of professionals, filtered to your taste, budget, and date.

booking.title: Seamless booking
booking.desc: Live calendars, instant requests, and contracts — no calls, no chasing, no friction.

tools.title: Planning tools
tools.desc: Checklists, payment tracking, invitation builder, and guest management — all in sync.

is_free.a: Yes — browsing vendors and managing your event is free. You only pay your vendors directly through the platform.

vetted.a: Every vendor on Vendora is hand-selected by our editorial team. We review portfolios and references before approval.

events.q: What types of events does Vendora support?
events.a: Weddings, corporate events, milestone celebrations, private parties — anything that deserves to be done well.

payments.q: Can I manage payments through Vendora?
payments.a: Yes. Send deposits, schedule installments, and keep every receipt in one place.
